preprocessing.name: canonical256_jpegpair_consistency_letterbox299
preprocessing.source_decode: Pillow decode followed by RGB conversion
preprocessing.shared_train_augmentation: one random horizontal flip p=0.5 shared by both views

objective.classification: cross-entropy on one uniformly sampled anchor JPEG view
objective.second_view_role: consistency regularization only, without an additional supervised cross-entropy term
objective.consistency: Jensen-Shannon divergence between the two class-probability distributions

optimization.reason: Keep the number of unique images per optimizer update aligned with the batch-16 baseline while fitting two views on a T4-class GPU.

model_selection.reason: Preserve direct checkpoint-selection comparability with the existing M7 Mixed-JPEG baseline.

baseline_reference.note: The anchor-view supervised objective matches one-view Mixed-JPEG training. The second view contributes only through consistency, so it does not double supervised label exposure.
